SUBMISSION_OUTPUT_PATH = "./submission/submission.csv"


def load_images_from_list(img_path_list):
    """Convert list of image paths to numpy array of shapes (n, 32, 32, 3)."""
    img_data = []
    for path in img_path_list:
        img_array = np.array(
            pd.read_csv(os.path.join("input", path)), dtype="float32"
        ).reshape(32, 32, 3)
        img_data.append(img_array)
    return np.array(img_data)


def main():

    # Identify image IDs and paths from metadata
    # Assumes file naming convention '{id}.jpg'
    id_to_image_path = {}

        # Clean ID

        # Just in case

        if fname_no_ext in id_to_image_path:
            arr = (
                np.array(pd.read_json(fp), dtype=np.float32)

    train_labels = train_df["has_cactus"].values

    # Hold-out validation split

        train_features,
        train_labels,
        test_size=0.2,
        random_state=42,
        stratify=train_labels,
    )

    # Initialize LightGBM
    # Params tuned for speed vs accuracy balance on small images
    params = {
        "objective": "binary",
        "metric": "binary_logloss",
        "boosting_type": "gbdt",
        "num_leaves": 31,
        "learning_rate": 0.05,

    # Dataset objects

    dval = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=X_train_full)

        cols["id"] = [item[0] for item in submission_data]
        cols["has_cactus"] = [
            float(item[1]) for item in submission_data

        df_sub = pd.DataFrame(cols)

        print("Submission saved successfully.")

        df_sub.to_csv(SUBMISSION_OUTPUT_PATH, index=False)
